title: Discovery to Architecture Handoff Artifact
description: Structured artifact produced by the Discovery Orchestrator and consumed by the Architecture Orchestrator. Contains the requirements specification, domain glossary, and prioritized backlog.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema used to produce the artifact. Must match the schema file version (e.g., '1.0').

projectName.description: Human-readable name of the target project as configured in This Project.

productVision.description: Structured product vision statement capturing the core problem and desired outcomes.

problemStatement.description: One to three sentences describing the core problem this system solves.

targetUsers.description: The primary user groups who will benefit from this system.

successMetrics.description: Measurable outcomes that define success for this project.

stakeholders.description: All identified parties who have an interest in or are affected by the system.

name.description: Stakeholder name or role title (e.g., 'Operations Manager').

interest.description: What this stakeholder needs from the system and why.

domainGlossary.description: Preliminary ubiquitous language terms established during Discovery. All subsequent phases use these terms verbatim.

term.description: The domain term exactly as it should appear in code and documentation.

definition.description: Clear, unambiguous definition of this term within the project domain.

context.description: The bounded context or subdomain in which this term is used.

requirements.description: Structured requirements elicited from stakeholders, separated by type.

functional.description: What the system must do - behaviors and capabilities.

description.description: Full description of the required behavior.

nonFunctional.description: Quality attributes the system must satisfy - performance, security, scalability, etc.

description.description: Specific, measurable statement of the non-functional requirement.

constraints.description: Fixed limitations the system must operate within - regulatory, technical, budget, or timeline.

prioritizedBacklog.description: Ranked list of requirements from highest to lowest priority, with acceptance criteria.

rank.description: Priority rank where 1 is highest priority.

requirementId.description: Reference to a requirement id in the requirements.functional array.

title.description: Short label copied from the referenced requirement.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given/When/Then statements defining when this requirement is satisfied.

processValidation.description: Discovery Artifact Validator sign-off confirming the Discovery phase is complete and the artifact is ready for Architecture.

validatedBy.description: Name of the agent that performed process validation (always 'discovery-artifact-validator').

gaps.description: Any identified gaps, open questions, or risks carried forward to Architecture. Empty array if none.

readinessConfirmed.description: True only when the Scrum Master confirms all Discovery deliverables are complete and no blocking gaps remain.

ticketKey.description: Optional validated TICKET_KEY scoping this run to knowledge-base/plans/active/<TICKET_KEY>/. Must match the pattern ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[1-9][0-9]*$. Absent for offline runs.

sessionPath.description: Optional active artifact directory derived from ticketKey. Defaults to knowledge-base/plans/active/ when absent.
